tasks.title: Add the atomic proxy attempt receipt at the provider lifecycle
tasks.description: Use the supported correlation value to add a small schema-defined, process-safe attempt receipt at the Bundjil proxy/provider boundary. Reuse AtomicKeyValueStore and the existing Upstash Layer, record the actual provider stream lifecycle, and keep Effect logs as supporting observations only.
implementationNotes: Own CodexProxyAttemptReceipt, its branded key/prefix contract, and the safe phase vocabulary in the existing provider contract owner. Use explicit Type and Encoded forms and one inbound/outbound codec at each boundary.

Reuse AtomicKeyValueStore.transact with the existing Upstash atomic implementation and an explicit memory Layer. Do not use generic KeyValueStore.modify, read-then-write logic, a new storage wrapper, or the channel replay store.

Atomically claim an absent logical key, record upstreamStarted immediately before actual provider egress, record provider retry ordinals including 401 refresh retries, and record completed only after the SSE body reaches its terminal marker. Record failed or unknown on observed failure or interruption.

Place completion/failure observation around actual stream consumption and resource finalization, not merely stream construction. Use Effect.Clock for timestamps and recovery decisions; never read ambient Date.now in the primary Effect.

On a completed replay, return the durable result without a second provider request. On unknown, fail closed or enter an explicitly owned recovery route. Do not claim exactly-once remote execution without an upstream idempotency contract.

Emit native Effect.logInfo records after durable transitions with only the branded opaque key, model, effort, mode, phase, ordinal, status, SSE boolean, and bounded timestamp. Never use logs as the durable oracle.
